headline_marked: [[Cox's Bazar hotel fire]]: 300 tourists evacuated safely from The Sea Princess
headline: Cox's Bazar hotel fire: 300 tourists evacuated safely from The Sea Princess
summary: A fire broke out at The Sea Princess Hotel in Cox's Bazar on Friday afternoon, prompting the evacuation of over 300 tourists. The blaze was quickly brought under control, and no injuries were reported.
details: A fire erupted at The Sea Princess Hotel in Cox's Bazar on Friday afternoon, just a week after a deadly resort fire in the same district. The blaze started in the ground-floor parking area, reportedly due to a short circuit in a generator.

Fire services were alerted and dispatched a unit to the scene. However, hotel authorities managed to control the fire before the fire service arrived. The quick action prevented the situation from escalating.

Over 300 tourists were present in the hotel at the time of the incident. Hotel management confirmed that all tourists were safely evacuated and no one was injured. The hotel's fire-fighting facilities and staff preparedness were credited with averting a major disaster.

While the fire was contained, some parts of the parking area, including the generator, sustained damage. The incident has raised concerns about fire safety in tourist accommodations in Cox's Bazar, especially following the recent tragedy at another resort.

headline_marked: [[One dead, 15 injured]] in head-on bus collision in Natore
headline: One dead, 15 injured in head-on bus collision in Natore
summary: A passenger bus collided head-on with another bus in Natore's Borai gram, killing one person and injuring at least 15 others. The injured have been hospitalized.
details: A head-on collision between two buses in Borai gram, Natore, has resulted in one fatality and left at least 15 people injured. The accident occurred on Friday evening.
The incident involved Tabassum Paribahan, traveling from Dhaka to Natore, and Desh Travels, heading from Natore to Dhaka. The collision took place around 6 PM near the Thana Mor area.

Local sources reported that one person died at the scene. The identity of the deceased is currently being verified. At least 15 individuals sustained injuries and were subsequently transported to a local hospital for medical attention.

The officer-in-charge of the Bonpara Highway Police Station, Abdus Salam, confirmed that the body of the deceased has been recovered and kept at the highway police station. Legal proceedings are underway regarding the incident.
